field.name: Link
field.summary: True when the Tool host lifetime should also be registered in the managed application host services.

field.name: Connect
field.summary: True when a shared instance should be registered in the managed application host services.

field.name: Console
field.summary: True when the ToolGenericHost should use console lifetime behavior.

field.name: hostbuilder
field.summary: The managed used when host-builder mode is active.

field.name: builder
field.summary: The managed used when application-builder mode is active.

method.name: CreateApplicationConnection
method.summary: Create and register the shared connection when application connection is enabled.
method.param: The Tool host lifetime; no connection is created when it is absent.
method.returns: The registered connection, or null when connection is disabled or no Tool lifetime is available.
method.remarks: Registers the connection with the active or service configuration.

method.name: LinkApplicationLifetime
method.summary: Register the Tool host lifetime in managed generic host services when lifetime linking is enabled.
method.param: The Tool host lifetime to register.
method.remarks: Does nothing when linking is disabled or no Tool lifetime is available. Registration supports both generic host builder modes.

method.name: configuretoolgenerichost
method.summary: Execute Tool Generic Host Configuration Actions.

method.name: configuretoolgenerichostasync
method.returns: A Task that represents the asynchronous operation.

method.name: ConfigureToolGenericHost_NoSync
method.summary: Add a tool generic host configuration action without acquiring the builder synchronization semaphore.
method.remarks: Registers a synchronous ToolGenericHost-configuration step in the shared ordered ToolGenericHost-configuration pipeline.

method.name: ConfigureToolGenericHostAsync_NoSync
method.summary: Add an async ToolGenericHost configuration action without acquiring the builder synchronization semaphore.
method.remarks: Registers an asynchronous ToolGenericHost-configuration step in the shared ordered ToolGenericHost-configuration pipeline.
